intro: Smith Mathiel is a pivotal warrior quest in Darnassus marking the transition from raw materials to forged arms. Having secured sacred elunite ore from a shipwreck off Auberdine, an aspiring warrior delivers the ore to the master blacksmith Mathiel. He agrees to work the blessed metal into a weapon fit for defending the Kaldorei.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have placed the elunite you gathered into a case. Take it to the blacksmith Mathiel, and he will craft for you an elunite weapon.
Mathiel is to the south, on the other side of this building.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, young adventurer. How might my skills serve you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, elunite ore. This is a fine metal to work with, for it is blessed by the goddess Elune herself. It would be an honor to craft weapons with it.
